snippet.title: (Reupload) マジデス壊 魔法少女マジカルデストロイヤーズ【PV】
snippet.description:
Magical Girl Destroyers Kai PV.
This was the trailer for the gacha game which was shut down on August 31, 2023.
Reuploaded for preservation, because it's an amazing trailer.

Song is リベリオン · Sumire Uesaka
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lsBlrocuNY0
